# NASA cFE primary header

Upstream: https://github.com/nasa/cFE/blob/main/modules/msg/option_inc/default_cfe_msg_hdr_pri.h
License: Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE). The header file is the upstream source, unchanged.

`@infinitum/autonomy` writes the six-byte CCSDS primary header from `CFE_MSG_CMD_HDR_INIT`. It does not compile or link the cFE flight software.
